accept.description: Comma-separated extensions, MIME types and MIME wildcards allowed in new selections.

browse-label.description: Visible text of the native file picker button.

cancel-label.description: Accessible name template for cancellation. Use {file} for the displayed filename.

count-error.description: Rejection text for a file beyond selection capacity.

disabled.description: Disables the picker and file actions and excludes the field from submission.

done-label.description: Status text for a completed upload.

drop-label.description: Drop instruction shown just before the Browse button.

error-text.description: Application validation error. Clear it to allow form submission again.

failed-label.description: Fallback status text for a failed upload without a supplied error.

help-text.description: Guidance for file formats, limits or the purpose of this field.

label.description: Visible label and accessible name of the upload group.

list-label.description: Accessible name of the list of files.

max-files.description: Maximum accepted local files as a nonnegative integer. Single-file mode also caps this at one.

max-size.description: Maximum size per selected file in bytes or decimal B, KB, MB or GB, such as "10MB".

multiple.description: Allows a selection of more than one file.

name.description: Form-data key repeated for each accepted original file.

queued-label.description: Status text for an accepted file waiting to upload.

remove-label.description: Accessible name template for removal. Use {file} for the displayed filename.

required.description: Requires at least one original accepted file to submit the form.

required-label.description: Visible annotation for a required file field.

required-message.description: Validation message when the form requires a file and none is selected.

size-error.description: Rejection text for a file larger than max-size.

type-error.description: Rejection text for a file that does not match accept.

uploading-label.description: Progress indicator name template. Use {file} for the displayed filename.

--ki-corner-inline.description: Small radius for an outline around inline content.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-file-upload-active-bg.description: Drop zone background while files are dragged over it.

--ki-file-upload-active-border.description: Drop zone boundary while files are dragged over it.

--ki-file-upload-active-fg.description: Main drop zone text while files are dragged over it.

--ki-file-upload-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter applied behind the drop zone.

--ki-file-upload-bg-image.description: Optional image over the drop zone background.

--ki-file-upload-border.description: Dashed boundary of the drop zone.

--ki-file-upload-border-width.description: Outline stroke width for the drop zone and file rows.

--ki-file-upload-error-bg.description: Background of a file row with an error.

--ki-file-upload-error-border.description: Boundary of a file row with an error.

--ki-file-upload-error-fg.description: Text of a file error or field error.

--ki-file-upload-fg.description: Main drop zone text at rest.

--ki-file-upload-row-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter applied behind a file row.

--ki-file-upload-row-bg.description: Background of a file row and the field label.

--ki-file-upload-row-bg-image.description: Optional image over the file row background.

--ki-file-upload-row-border.description: Boundary of a file row without an error.

--ki-file-upload-row-fg.description: File names, row action icons and the field label.

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-layout-spacing-3xl.description: The 3xl spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-md.description: The md spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-layout-spacing-xs.description: The xs spacing step for a stack or grid gap.

--ki-text-primary-high-em.description: semantic color for text primary high em.

--ki-text-supporting.description: Supporting text of an enabled control: field labels, placeholders, list secondary lines, quiet button labels and unselected tabs. A role, distinct from the med-em emphasis step it resolves to, so a mode can strengthen enabled supporting text without touching the disabled ink that also draws from med-em (directly, or through text.muted).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-underline-offset.description: Gap between text and its underline.

--ki-typography-underline-thickness.description: Stroke width of a resting text underline.

--ki-typography-underline-thickness-hove.description: Stroke width of an emphasized underline on hover.

--ki-typography-visually-hidden-size.description: Nonzero edge for clipped text available to assistive technology.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

--ki-typography-weight-body-normal.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body normal.

component.description:
A form-associated picker and drop zone with local selection validation and a
list of file upload outcomes.

ki-file-cancel.description: Requests that the application cancel the identified upload.

ki-file-remove.description: Reports a row removed by the user, after updating the file list.

ki-files-add.description: Reports the accepted rows in one picker or drop batch, each with its original File.

action.description: Native button for removal or cancellation.

browse.description: Native button that opens the file picker.

drop-zone.description: Surface that receives files dragged from the operating system.

file-meta.description: Size, outcome or error text for the file.

label.description: Field label and optional required annotation.

list.description: List of selected files and rejections.

progress.description: Progress indicator for an uploading file.

row.description: A file row, with data-status matching its lifecycle state.

dropLabel.description: Drop instruction shown just before the Browse button.

errorText.description: Application validation error. Clear it to allow form submission again.

failedLabel.description: Fallback status text for a failed upload without a supplied error.

files.description:
Displayed file records, including rejections. Assign a new array to update
progress or outcomes. Keep each original File on its record for form
submission. Set this as a JavaScript property when supplying file records.
